description: This PHP source file defines the DefaultTimesheetAPI class within the OrangeHRM Time module. It provides an API endpoint for retrieving default timesheet data, supporting filtering by date and employee number. The class includes methods for handling the API request, validating parameters, and returning timesheet data wrapped in model objects.
